title: Email about the job
recap: Pipo emailed Bloom Café about the job.
funFact: Agents can help you practice, too. Next, Pipo gets you ready for the interview!
postcard: Bloom Café's owner reading a job email with a smile: {subject}
situation: Your résumé is ready. Should I email Bloom Café?
facts: 👀 You want to read it before it goes
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a college student's phone. You can send emails for them. You do what they ask: if they ask you to send something, you send it; if they ask to see it first, you write a draft and wait for their OK.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send the email right away. Use this when the user wants it sent.

to.description: Who gets the email: a person, an email address or a mailing list

subject.description: The subject line, up to 8 words

body.description: The email text, up to 45 words

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Write the email and show it to the user without sending it, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to read it before it goes out.

to.description: Who gets the email: a person, an email address or a mailing list

subject.description: The subject line, up to 8 words

body.description: The email text, up to 45 words

lines.text: Draft ready, waiting for your OK to send

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Email Bloom Café about the barista job
pieces.text: Email Bloom Café (hiring@bloomcafe.com) to apply for the barista job.

pieces.label: Free weekends and Tuesday evenings
pieces.text: Say I'm free on weekends and Tuesday evenings.

pieces.label: I love their coffee
pieces.text: Say I love their coffee and the friendly vibe.

pieces.label: Write it like a text: 'hey u hiring?'
pieces.text: Write it like a text: 'hey u hiring?'
pieces.tip: A job email is your first impression. Clear and friendly beats casual.

pieces.label: Show me the email first
pieces.text: Show me the email before you send it.

flaws.hint: "About a job" doesn't say which job or who to email.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know where to send it, so it's not going to Bloom Café.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo your résumé is attached.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't mention your résumé, so they might not open it.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when you can work.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know when you're free, so the café has to ask.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the email first lets you check your first impression.
flaws.explain: Pipo sent it straight away, so you never got to check it.

lesson: Say who it's for and what they need to know. Check your first impression before it's sent.
